about_the_game:
🔥 A Lone Soldier. A Dead City. A Nightmare That Never Ends. 🔥💀

The city lies in ruins, overrun by a deadly plague and bloodthirsty zombies. Once full of life, it is now a wasteland of death. You are the last survivor… or so you think. Every alley is a death trap, every shadow hides something waiting to strike.

🏚️ Survival & Exploration Horror

  • Explore a vast abandoned city filled with danger, secrets, and horrors.

  • Scavenge weapons, ammo, and medical supplies to stay alive.

  • Face advanced AI enemies that stalk and ambush you unexpectedly.

🎮 Intense Combat & Tactical Survival

  • Use guns, melee weapons, and explosives to take down the undead.

  • Rely on stealth, movement, and strategic planning to survive.

  • Experience realistic ballistics, destructible environments, and a deep survival system.

🚧 A Wrecked, Unforgiving World

  • Navigate crumbling buildings, abandoned streets, and wrecked cars that once stood as monuments to civilization.

  • Use rooftops, underground tunnels, and shelters to avoid danger and find resources.

⚔️ Game Modes & Challenges

  • Survival Mode: Fight against hunger, infection, and relentless zombie hordes.

  • Story-Driven Missions: Uncover the truth behind the terrifying outbreak.

  • Hardcore Survival Challenges: Can you last when ammo is scarce and death lurks around every corner?

💥 The city is against you. The monsters are hunting you. Fear is your only companion. Will you survive? 🎮🔥

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (v.1803 or higher)
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 5.1+ Recommended
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 64-bit (latest update)
  • Processor: Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 2060 super or AMD RX 6600-XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: 5.1+ Recommended
  • VR Support: no
  • Additional Notes: SSD Recommended

short_description: Survive the ultimate nightmare in a zombie-infested city! Scavenge weapons, battle relentless undead, and uncover the dark secret behind the outbreak. No escape, no mercy—only the strongest will last! 🔥🧟‍♂️🔥🎮
